source: Reproduced from economic_model.py's build_segmentation_model() -- same RANDOM_SEED, same synthetic-population formulas, same LogisticRegression call as the run that produced economic_model.json's ml_segmentation block.
methodology: 50,000-person synthetic population calibrated to FinScope Tanzania 2023 distributions (mm_penetration_pct from finscope_summary.json's real mm_rate). A random 5,000-person subsample of that same population and model is persisted here (not a new model or a new population, and not the full 50,000 -- a representative slice of it, documented as such) -- this keeps the per-individual predicted probabilities and raw features that build_segmentation_model() computes but does not save; economic_model.json keeps only the per-lifecycle-stage aggregates.
